messages:
Elaine: Quick follow-up from the DR postmortem — I'm consolidating the remediation list. Can owners claim items here?
Matan: I can take multi-region routing tests. Planning a game-day rehearsal next Wed.
Aoife: I'll own restore-runbook updates and add explicit rollback steps.
Samir: I'll take backups + replication validation (checksums & test restores).
Jules: I'll automate DB snapshot verification in CI — smoke restore + schema check.
Katie: heads-up: dedicated eu-west capacity is constrained on 2026-04-01..03, might affect full failover sims.
OpsBot: Reminder: DR game day scheduled for 2026-03-30 09:00 UTC. RSVP in #incidents by EOD Fri.
Elaine: Proposed SLAs for closures: P0 (critical) = 14 days, P1 = 30 days. Agree? :thinking_face:
Matan: agree for criticals. For routing tests, I propose two passes: routing-only, then full-service failover.
Aoife: can we add a staging dry-run with synthetic traffic? need to confirm KV cache warmup behavior.
Samir: yes, schedule a staging dry-run. I'll provide a restore bucket and creds for the test account.
Matan: test plan sketch:
``n- test: routing-only-failover
- steps: 1) switch BGP announce to failover-prefix 2) validate 95th latency + error rate 3) confirm traffic split in telemetry
- rollback: revert BGP, confirm routes propagate, verify cache hits > 80%
```
Aoife: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/runbooks/pull/42 — added rollback checklist and a post-failover validation step (search, auth, embeddings).
Jules: I'll add a CI job: snapshot-restore-smoke + fingerprint verification. ETA 7 days.
Katie: note: cross-region snapshot retention policy needs legal/exec signoff before we increase retention. Filing ticket with legal.
Elaine: assigning owners + deadlines:
- multi-region routing tests — Matan — 2026-04-06
- restore runbook update — Aoife — 2026-03-31
- backup validation automation — Jules — 2026-03-30
- capacity confirmation for eu-west — Katie — 2026-03-28
- backup integrity & test restores — Samir — 2026-03-30
Elaine: I'll update the action-tracker sheet and ping owners tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
Matan: acked — I'll also post the game-day checklist in #eng-sre and tag infra.
Aoife: small ask — can infra provide 2x smaller instance types for staging to mimic cache cold starts?
Samir: we can spin up spot instances for the window, adding to the game-day plan.
Elaine: ideal outcome: routing fallback works without data loss, restores complete within RTO target, and we have clear exec approvals for retention.
Jules: I'm logging the CI tasks and will post PR links in this thread when ready.
Katie: I'll coordinate with finance/legal about retention cost impact and approval path.
Elaine: thanks all — if anyone hits blockers, flag here. Closing this sync; will re-open thread after the tracker is updated.
